results.question: how many things can i pick up at west village, broken down by category?

results.question: average agreed price of completed bike sales in 2025

results.question: which meetup spot got the most new listings in spring 2026?
results.sql:
SELECT ms.name AS meetup_spot, COUNT(*) AS new_listings
FROM nlq.listings_all la
JOIN nlq.meetup_spots ms ON la.spot_id = ms.spot_id
JOIN nlq.calendar c ON la.listed_on = c.day
WHERE c.semester = 'Spring'
  AND c.academic_year = '2025-26'
  AND la.status = 'available'
GROUP BY ms.name
ORDER BY new_listings DESC
LIMIT 1;
results.answer: Snell Library had the most new listings in Spring 2026, with 60 listings.

results.question: what share of all listings ever posted were offered for rent?

       SUM(CASE WHEN is_for_rent THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rent_listings,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN is_for_rent THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0), 2) AS rent_share_percent
FROM nlq.listings_all;
results.answer: Across all time, 24.96% of the listings ever posted were offered for rent, which is 3,231 out of 12,947 listings.

results.question: for each category, how many days on average does it take an item to sell?
results.sql:
SELECT la.category,
       ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (d.completed_at - la.listed_at))/86400)::numeric, 2) AS avg_days_to_sell
FROM nlq.deals d
JOIN nlq.listings_all la ON la.item_id = d.item_id
WHERE d.deal_type = 'sale'
  AND d.status = 'completed'
  AND la.is_for_sale = true
GROUP BY la.category
ORDER BY la.category;
results.answer: Across all time, the average days to sell vary by category: bikes_transport takes 11.20 days, clothing 11.32 days, dorm_essentials 11.39 days, electronics 11.40 days, furniture 11.61 days, kitchen 11.49 days, other 12.08 days, sports_outdoors 11.56 days, and textbooks 11.56 days.

results.question: what share of conversations led to a request, by meetup spot?
results.sql:
SELECT ms.name AS meetup_spot,
       COUNT(*) AS total_conversations,
       SUM(CASE WHEN cv.led_to_request THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS conversations_led_to_request,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN cv.led_to_request THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0), 2) AS share_percent
FROM nlq.conversations cv
JOIN nlq.listings_all la ON cv.item_id = la.item_id
JOIN nlq.meetup_spots ms ON la.spot_id = ms.spot_id
GROUP BY ms.name
ORDER BY ms.name;
results.answer: Across all time, conversations led to a request at each meetup spot: Curry Student Center had 2,825 out of 4,597 conversations (61.45%), Fenway (off campus) had 636 out of 1,011 (62.91%), International Village had 2,241 out of 3,557 (63.00%), Marino Recreation Center had 1,430 out of 2,248 (63.61%), Mission Hill (off campus) had 953 out of 1,527 (62.41%), Snell Library had 3,460 out of 5,554 (62.30%), and West Village had 1,892 out of 2,977 (63.55%).

results.question: late-return rate for rentals due during finals compared with rentals due during regular classes
results.sql:

  c.period AS period,
  COUNT(*) AS total_rentals,
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN d.returned_late THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::numeric, 2) AS late_return_rate
FROM nlq.deals d
JOIN nlq.calendar c ON d.rental_due_date = c.day
WHERE d.deal_type = 'rental'
  AND d.rental_returned_at IS NOT NULL
  AND c.period IN ('finals', 'classes')
GROUP BY c.period;
results.answer: There were 2,742 rentals due during regular classes with a late‑return rate of 20%, and 134 rentals due during finals with a late‑return rate of 19%.
